title: Application crash loop
report: The orders-api keeps restarting and the orders page is down.

also_accept.why: the only visible cause is the log line 'FATAL: DATABASE_URL is not set'; a missing setting is an equally supported reading

example.root_cause: orders-api exits at start-up with 'FATAL: DATABASE_URL is not set', so its pod crash-loops
example.fix: set DATABASE_URL in the orders-api Deployment's environment
